0022600094.text: The Atlanta Hawks (1-0, first in the Southeast and second in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (1-0, third in the Southeast and sixth in the East), with both teams unbeaten so far this season. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Hawks lost the season series 1-3, including a 110-107 defeat in Charlotte on February 11, 2026.
